'''2013 Worlds Day 2 John Veasey LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name box on the Day 2 sheet is VeeZ.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
